description: This Java class provides utility functions for managing 'Manager' entities in a database, including validation, creation, updating, and deletion operations.

classes.name: ManagerDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for database operations related to the 'Manager' entity, including validation, insertion, update, and deletion.

methods.name: validateManager
methods.description: Validates a manager's credentials using email and password, returning a Manager object if successful.

methods.name: insertManager
methods.description: Inserts a new manager into the database, creating entries in both 'employee' and 'manager' tables.

methods.name: updateManager
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing manager in the database.

methods.name: deleteManager
methods.description: Deletes a manager from the database, removing entries from both 'manager' and 'employee' tables.

methods.name: updateManagerWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates manager details excluding the image URL.
